question: Between April 1 and July 31 of 2017, using the hits product revenue data along with the totals transactions to classify sessions as purchase (transactions ≥ 1 and productRevenue not null) or non-purchase (transactions null and productRevenue null), compare the average pageviews per visitor for each group by month
sql:
WITH product_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    t.fullVisitorId,
    t.visitId,
    t.date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS t,
  UNNEST(t.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
  GROUP BY t.fullVisitorId, t.visitId, t.date
),
all_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    date,
    totals.pageviews,
    totals.transactions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
)
SELECT 
  SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 6) AS month,
  CASE 
    WHEN a.transactions >= 1 AND COALESCE(p.has_product_revenue, 0) = 1 THEN 'purchase'
    WHEN a.transactions IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.has_product_revenue, 0) = 0 THEN 'non-purchase'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS session_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.fullVisitorId) AS visitor_count,
  AVG(a.pageviews) AS avg_pageviews
FROM all_sessions a
LEFT JOIN product_hits p 
  ON a.fullVisitorId = p.fullVisitorId AND a.visitId = p.visitId AND a.date = p.date
GROUP BY month, session_type
ORDER BY month, session_type
